limitations: acquisition_clause_presence adjudications are not materialized in world.sqlite; derivation reads 05_dispositions.json as a prior-pass input.
legal_name_variant_pair is not materialized in world.sqlite; identity_judgment tuples already subsume required B links.
contract_clause_excerpt is absent for SOW-VEL-2022; obligation and acquisition judgments for that contract remain UNRESOLVED in upstream artifacts.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical string normalization only; does not assert identity and emits no unresolved state.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is the cross product of registry legal_name values with billing billed_name and CRM account_name strings after deterministic suffix normalization.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Normalize legal suffixes (Ltd/Limited, Inc./Incorporated, GmbH, LLC) and emit pairs where normalized forms match exactly.
derivations.required_premise: registry_entity_record and at least one commercial name field from invoice_record or crm_account_record.
derivations.optional_enrichment: crm_account_record when billing names are absent for a commercially relevant account.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter on source-authored status; no epistemic judgment.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is invoice_record; completeness is COMPLETE over that relation.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice, invoice_id, status FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record.status copied verbatim from billing sources.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose-A policy predicate; expired SOW documents are inactive, MSAs without explicit past expiry are active.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is contract_record; one active flag per contract tuple.
derivations.deterministic_computation: active=false when document_kind='SOW' and expiry_date parses to a date before the reference date; otherwise active=true.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: contract_record.expiry_date empty for non-SOW documents (treated as active under purpose-A policy)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose-C policy predicate; any contract with explicit past expiry is inactive.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is contract_record; one active flag per contract tuple.
derivations.deterministic_computation: active=false when expiry_date parses to a date before the reference date; otherwise active=true.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: contract_record.expiry_date empty (treated as active under purpose-C policy)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Include invoice rows tied to an active purpose-A contract with at least one acquisition-relevant clause PRESENT; association is asserted on SAME_ENTITY billing-to-contract identity and unresolved otherwise. Absence from output is not a negative exposure finding.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row universe is invoice_record tuples that share an identity_judgment edge to a contract and pass active-contract and acquisition-clause gates; invoices blocked only by association uncertainty are still emitted with association=unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice billed_name to contract via identity_judgment; filter purpose_a_active_contract and any acquisition_clause_presence PRESENT; map SAME_ENTITY to association asserted and UNRESOLVED to association unresolved; sort by invoice_id.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record fields, identity_judgment on billing:<billed_name> to contract:<contract_id>, and at least one acquisition_clause_presence PRESENT for the governing contract.
derivations.optional_enrichment: acquisition_clause_presence from 05_dispositions.json when not present in world.sqlite.
blocking_unresolved_state: acquisition_clause_presence UNRESOLVED for all kinds on a contract (contract excluded from exposure universe)
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-to-contract path (invoice still emitted with association unresolved)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Project admitted identity judgments for required commercial connection paths; epistemic values SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED. DISTINCT requires establishing evidence; absence of SAME_ENTITY does not imply DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is the identity_judgment tuples compiled for required crm–billing, commercial–contract, and registry-candidate pairs; completeness follows world identity_judgment coverage.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT left, right, disposition AS epistemic FROM identity_judgment ORDER BY left, right.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment tuples along purpose-B required connection paths.
derivations.optional_enrichment: legal_name_variant_pair for mechanical legal-form promotion when upstream identity tuples are absent.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED (emitted explicitly as epistemic UNRESOLVED)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit dependent when current commercial relationship holds and at least one obligation kind is PRESENT with resolved billing-to-contract identity; emit unresolved when evaluation is blocked solely by UNRESOLVED identity on the invoice–contract join. Unresolved identity is not evidence of non-dependence.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row universe is billing-to-contract pairs with an identity_judgment edge that either satisfy dependence predicates or are blocked solely by unresolved identity; pairs failing predicates without identity blockage are omitted.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each billing-to-contract identity edge, collect open invoice_ids, PRESENT obligation kinds, test current relationship (open invoice OR active contract with auto_renewal/rolling_term PRESENT); status dependent when relationship and obligations hold with SAME_ENTITY identity, unresolved when identity is UNRESOLVED.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment on billing:<billed_name> to contract:<contract_id>, obligation_clause_presence dispositions, and invoice_record status for open invoices.
derivations.optional_enrichment: purpose_c_active_contract precomputed flags; open_invoice materialized subset.
blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-to-contract join forces status unresolved
non_blocking_unresolved_state: obligation_clause_presence UNRESOLVED for a kind (kind omitted from obligation_kinds; does not alone force unresolved status)
obligation_clause_presence UNRESOLVED for all kinds (row omitted unless identity alone blocks evaluation)
